NoteItem.title: NoteItem
NoteItem.description: A user-authored or AI-transcribed bilingual note belonging to an authenticated user.

title.description: Concise title of the note (1-120 chars).

content.description: Full Bangla or English note body (1-10000 chars).

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top.

languageTag.description: Detected or selected language tag (e.g. bn, en, bn-en).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ReminderItem.title: ReminderItem
ReminderItem.description: A scheduled task or reminder extracted from text/voice or created manually.

dueAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds for the scheduled reminder time.

category.description: Category tag such as Work, Personal, Health, Errands.

sourceText.description: Original unstructured text or voice transcript used to extract this reminder.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A bilingual Bangla-English AI chat message belonging to an authenticated user.

text.description: Message body in Bangla, English, or Banglish (1-15000 chars).

languageHint.description: Language mode active when sent (auto, bn, en).

AnswerCheckItem.title: AnswerCheckItem
AnswerCheckItem.description: An AI-evaluated question and user answer record with verdict, 0-100 score, breakdown, and explanation.

question.description: Question or claim being checked (1-2000 chars).

userAnswer.description: User's spoken or typed answer (1-4000 chars).

scoreReason.description: Concise explanation of why the score was awarded (1-1000 chars).

correctParts.description: Portions of the answer that are accurate (0-2000 chars).

incorrectParts.description: Portions of the answer that are inaccurate or missing (0-2000 chars).

inputLanguage.description: Language code or mode used (auto, bn, en).

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-scoped collection of notes and transcribed voice notes.

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: User-scoped collection of AI-extracted and manual reminders.

/users/{userId}/answerChecks/{checkId}.description: User-scoped AI Smart Answer Checker history and scores.
